pages.text: $(bold)Spell Break$() (comes with Mithril, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)Effect: the tool $(bold)comes with a level 1 Counterspell$() inscribed (an Iron's Spells spell that interrupts enemy casting or magic effects).

$(bold)How to use$(): hold it in your $(bold)main or off hand$() (wear it, for armor) and it shows up in the Iron's Spells $(bold)spell wheel$().$(br2)Select and cast it like a spellbook spell - it spends $(bold)your own mana$().

$(bold)It is written into the spell container$():$(li)the Arcane Anvil $(bold)can keep editing it$() (add or upgrade spells)$(li)with $(l:material_holy_spirit)Magic Conduction$() gear from elsewhere (Holy Spirit / Arcane Iron) you can raise that Counterspell to a higher level

$(bold)Never overwritten$(): items that already carry a container are not written again, and $(bold)manually edited containers stay intact$().$(br2)$(bold)Want to check it took?$() Hold the item and read its tooltip - the Spell Break line lists the $(bold)actually inscribed spells$().
$(italic)Spell Break is inactive while the item is broken (durability exhausted), and comes back once repaired.$()
